summary: Agent harness evolution enables recursive self-improvement (RSI) without updating model weights. We examine whether higher benchmark scores yield reliable, efficient, and transferable improvement.
takeaways: Repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions, and admission replays reveal recurring patterns.
These findings motivate preservation-aware evaluation, tested decision rules, and explicit applicability conditions.
